title: Made a free AI agent that refuses to write your Godot code for you (on purpose)
author: 3pumps1load

comments.author: Sufficient-Pop-1643
comments.body: Dude, this isn't an agent. You just made a bunch of MD files with restricted permissions (not even sure that works properly) and these files look like they were generated by AI. At least put together some skills for Godot that include real best practices, instead of just leaving it up to AI.

replies.author: 3pumps1load
replies.body: But that’s how agents work. You define the persona and how it works in an instruction file that the model pre reads when seeding configs

replies.author: Sufficient-Pop-1643
replies.body:
You don't really understand what an agent is. 

"An AI agent is an autonomous software system that uses artificial intelligence to perceive its environmental surroundings, make decisions, plan actions, and execute tasks to achieve a specific goal." (с) Google Gemini.

In fact, an agent is a set of instructions and tools; and often a specific sequence of actions - designed to perform a particular task. In your case, in order to call it an AI agent, you would have had to develop software that carried out at least some kind of sequence of actions. For example:

https://preview.redd.it/imzwhmw6wddh1.png?width=828&format=png&auto=webp&s=aaa3b448aa94b620d0f5fae87e950bedaaec4515

In your case, it's just a set of system prompts and a couple of skills.

replies.author: 3pumps1load
replies.body:
(From anthropic’s official course on Claude code)  
“Custom sub agents you define can use skills, but only if you explicitly list them. Skills are loaded when the subagent starts, not on demand like the main conversation.  
To create a custom subagent with skills, add an agent markdown file in .Claude/agents. You can use /agents command in Claude Code to create one interactively”

Does that answer your question now about what an agent is and why it’s just a .md file?

We can argue all you want about the proper definition of the word, but in the specific context that I mention it (Claude code/codex/cursor) it’s just an md file

replies.author: Sufficient-Pop-1643
replies.body: You’re free to stick to your own way of thinking. But in that case, your headline is pure clickbait to me. I’d love to see how people would react if Claude released an “Agent” like that. I thought you were mistaken, but it seems you knew exactly what you were doing. Time wasted.
